claim_boundary.preferred_title_framing: Early prediction of amyloid biomarker status and preclinical risk

claims.caveat: AB-positive vs AB-negative is not clinical Alzheimer diagnosis.
claims.current_mapping: Reframed as early prediction of amyloid biomarker status and preclinical risk unless an independent clinical label is used. Title framing: 'early prediction of amyloid biomarker status and preclinical risk'.
claims.proposal_claim: Early Alzheimer's disease diagnosis from MRI and clinical variables.

claims.caveat: PET is label source only, never Method X input.
claims.current_mapping: Method X-Strict protects PET-free inputs: T1 MRI plus age/sex/education/APOE4/MMSE.

claims.caveat: Method Y is paired subset only and PET-label tautology must be reported.
claims.current_mapping: Method Y includes PET-only, MRI-only paired, MRI+PET fusion, and MRI+PET+cognitive controlled extension.
claims.proposal_claim: Multimodal MRI, PET, and cognitive modeling.

claims.caveat: Report as controlled ablation, not confirmed pretrained transfer learning.
claims.current_mapping: MONAI ResNet/EfficientNet controlled ablations exist; true pretrained 3D fine-tuning is not claimed because no validated compatible pretrained 3D weights are locked in this repo.

claims.caveat: 6000 is augmented exposure count, not 6000 real subjects.
claims.current_mapping: Train-fold-only MONAI augmentation reports 4x augmented training exposures while real N remains unchanged.
claims.proposal_claim: Augmentation increases samples from 1500 to about 6000.

claims.caveat: Validation/test/holdout stay real; Method X never receives synthetic PET.
claims.current_mapping: Supplementary fold-local policy: generator fit only inside train fold; synthetic PET added only to same train fold.

claims.caveat: Test labels are not used for threshold selection.
claims.current_mapping: Threshold metrics are computed using thresholds selected from fold-internal validation data only.
claims.proposal_claim: Report accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1.

claims.caveat: Progression proxy, not clinical AD diagnosis.
claims.current_mapping: Clinical endpoint branch uses CDR worsening and PACC decline as progression proxies.
Public bundle is aggregate/hash-level only with raw data, HDF5, images, raw identifiers, raw paths, and subject-level predictions excluded.

claims.caveat: These are retained as current upgrades, not reverted to the initial proposal.
claims.current_mapping: Current project preserves SynIB, MFSCA, worst-dimension audit, FLAIR sensitivity, KD, cohort-probe, calibration, DCA, privacy, and claim-control workflows.
